settings.heading: The first tee is in the works
settings.text:
One shirt to start: heavyweight brown cotton, cream print, Hasna's on the back. It is drawn and it is close, but it is not printed yet.

We are working through fabric weight, print quality and sizing with a local Austin shop before anything goes on sale. When a piece is right, it goes up. Until then this page is the honest answer.
